domain: GPU instancing, flora, rocks, micro-detail optimization, visual scalability

touchedFiles.change: Replaced abrupt depth-band budget selection with hysteresis, smooth profile blending, and continuous GlobalQualityWeight scaling.
Added fail-closed finite guards for BRG matrix culling, culling planes, sphere visibility, and bounds visibility.
Compacts valid HLOD instances during upload, rejects invalid matrices/bounds/fades/origin-shift inputs, and provides a cached fallback runtime material from the assigned or hidden shader.
Rejects non-finite scatter placement positions and negative/non-finite spacing before native spatial bucket insertion.
Adds fail-closed finite guards for GPU culling constants, matrices, planes, bounds radius, voxel SDF coordinates, and sampled SDF values.
Sanitizes impostor atlas grid addressing by deriving inverse grid scale from columns/rows and wrapping view index by total cell count.

Adds fail-closed validation/compaction for distant landmark native bounds and HLOD payloads, validates external buffers, guards origin-shift bounds, and implements cached fallback silhouette material.
Wraps atlas view index by total grid cells and guards source/output texture dimensions before impostor atlas writes.
Clamps scatter generation and compaction to the real grid cell count and clears stale visibility for published candidates outside the valid grid window.
Clamps impostor edge dilation to the minimum real source/mask/output texture dimensions before sampling or writing atlas pixels.
Adds finite ingress guards for kelp vertex/global motion data and smooth _H8GlobalQualityWeight gates for sway, interaction deformation, MX350 motion cap, and high-quality parallax.
Adds sanitized touch-ripple count/vector guards and smooth _H8GlobalQualityWeight gates for coral ripple overkill and high-quality parallax.
Adds finite guards for geology impostor vertex position, UV, atlas sample, base color, alpha clip threshold, ambient floor, and fail-closed color output.
Adds finite fallbacks for SSAO projection/radius/intensity/sigma and float2-to-int rounding before sample offset generation.
Adds finite guards for voxel rock vertex/absolute positions, origin offset, biome grid casts, volume/cut/damage mask sampling, and caustic/noise data.
Adds source/result 3D texture dimension guards and finite stamp/world parameter guards before terrain damage volume reads/writes.
Clamps particle dispatch count to read/write buffer capacity, validates flow buffer capacity, and sanitizes particle/flow params before visual dispersion integration.
Adds finite ingress guards for sargassum vertex/color/UV/time/prop-wash/cut/sink/clip paths in forward and shadow passes.
Extends non-GPUI kelp finite ingress and continuous _H8GlobalQualityWeight motion gates into shadow and depth passes.
Sanitizes non-GPUI coral shadow normals before shadow bias; forward ripple and parallax quality gates were already present in baseline.
Keeps positionWS available to the low LOD branch and adds continuous _H8GlobalQualityWeight shaping for low matcap/emission and high blend sharpness.
Adds finite/fallback guards for cut-mask texel size, scroll offset, recovery, stamp payloads, and final output.
Guards facade output texture dimensions, density/cut rects, drift, pow/scales, and finite wave/oil mask writes.
Caps wake stamp iteration to owner buffer capacity and sanitizes wake samples, texel size, stamp payloads, runtime params, and output.
Consumes HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight for smooth visual-only wave/oil facade intensity scaling before compute dispatch.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch ScatterBudgetController selected Surface/MidDepth/Deep profile directly by depth thresholds and skipped only when the enum matched.
confirmedProblems.fix: Stable band uses hysteresis; effective runtime profile uses smooth interpolation around threshold windows.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch budget code did not read HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight.
confirmedProblems.fix: Scavenge radius, spawn cadence, collider radius, and collider operation cadence now scale continuously from survival to visual overkill.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch BRG culling accepted matrix axes, centers, culling planes, bounds, and radii without finite checks.
confirmedProblems.fix: Invalid culling inputs now return invisible or write a zero visibility byte before draw command output.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch HLOD upload copied every instance and merged bounds without validating LocalToWorld, LocalBounds, Fade01, or origin-shift input.
confirmedProblems.fix: Invalid HLOD records are skipped while valid records are compacted and uploaded contiguously.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch scatter placement registration inserted Position and EffectiveSpacing into native spatial buckets without finite/non-negative validation.
confirmedProblems.fix: Invalid position or spacing is rejected before capacity growth and bucket insertion.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch compute culling used cull distance, instance radius, matrix rows, frustum planes, voxel SDF transform, UVW coordinates, and sampled SDF values without complete finite validation.
confirmedProblems.fix: Invalid GPU culling inputs now fail closed before visibility writes, distance branches, voxel casts, or sampled SDF decisions.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch HectonImpostorAtlasUv used atlasGrid.zw for UV cell scale even when atlasGrid.xy columns/rows were the authoritative grid.
confirmedProblems.fix: Cell scale is derived from sanitized columns/rows and view index is wrapped within total cell count.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch HectonHLODRenderer serialized a shader and documented Hidden/Hecton/HLOD fallback, but ResolveMaterial returned only an assigned Material.
confirmedProblems.fix: ResolveMaterial now creates and reuses one hidden runtime material from the assigned shader or fallback shader.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch HectonDistantLandmarkRenderer accepted external buffers, native Bounds, native HLODData, origin shifts, and draw bounds without finite validation.
confirmedProblems.fix: Invalid payloads now clear binding or are skipped while valid native entries are compacted into contiguous upload buffers.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch HectonDistantLandmarkRenderer serialized _silhouetteShader and documented hidden fallback material behavior, but ResolveMaterial returned only _material.
confirmedProblems.fix: ResolveMaterial now creates and reuses one hidden runtime material from assigned or Hidden/Hecton8/World/DistantLandmarkSilhouette shader.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch PackImpostorAtlas.compute clamped _ViewIndex only to non-negative and did not guard source/output texture dimensions.
confirmedProblems.fix: View index is wrapped by atlasGrid.x * atlasGrid.y; source pixels are clamped to source dimensions and output pixels outside target dimensions are rejected.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_GpuScatter.compute used _HectonScatterCandidateCount for generate/compact bounds without clamping to _HectonScatterGridResolution squared.
confirmedProblems.fix: Generate and compact kernels now use ResolveGridCandidateCount and clear stale visibility for candidate indices outside the valid grid-cell window.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch DilateImpostorEdges.compute used _AtlasSize for source, mask, and output texture access without checking actual texture dimensions.
confirmedProblems.fix: Dilation now reads real source/mask/output dimensions and clamps the working atlas size to their shared valid area.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_KelpMaster_GPUI.shader used raw vertex positions/normals, _TotalUniverseOffset, sway constants, _Time, UV height, and vertex color seeds in forward/shadow/depth motion, while MX350/high-quality paths had fixed behavior inside the active variant.
confirmedProblems.fix: Kelp motion now sanitizes finite ingress data and consumes _H8GlobalQualityWeight through smooth gates for sway, interaction deformation, MX350 motion cap, and high parallax.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_CoralMaster_GPUI.shader cast _BiolumTouchRippleParams.x directly and consumed _BiolumTouchRipples entries without finite validation; touch ripple and high parallax were not continuously quality-gated.
confirmedProblems.fix: Coral ripple count and entries are sanitized before use, and ripple energy plus high parallax now consume smooth _H8GlobalQualityWeight gates.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_GeologyImpostorBillboard.shader sampled the atlas and clipped alpha from raw vertex UV/material values without finite guards.
confirmedProblems.fix: The billboard shader now sanitizes vertex position, UV, base color, atlas sample, alpha clip threshold, ambient floor, and final color.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_VoxelSSAO.compute derived radiusPixels and sample offsets from raw _HectonVoxelSSAOParamsA values before float-to-int rounding.
confirmedProblems.fix: SSAO projection/radius/intensity/sigma and rounded float2 offsets now use finite fallbacks before texture loads.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_AbyssalVoxelRock.shader used unchecked positions, origin offsets, biome grid params, mask rects, damage volume params, and caustic layer/time data before int casts, texture samples, and displacement/noise math.
confirmedProblems.fix: Voxel rock now sanitizes scalar/vector ingress and fails closed around biome grid casts, carve masks, damage volume masks, displacement, and caustic/noise inputs.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_TerrainDamageVolume.compute trusted authored resolution and stamp/world params before Texture3D.Load, RWTexture3D writes, radius math, and output.
confirmedProblems.fix: The kernel now clamps to the shared source/result 3D texture dimensions and sanitizes world, recovery, radius, strength, current, and output values.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch ParticleUpdate.compute cast _FieldParams.y to uint directly and indexed the flow field from unchecked resolution/origin/cell-size data.
confirmedProblems.fix: Particle count is clamped to read/write buffer capacity; flow sampling is rejected if required samples exceed buffer capacity; particle and flow state is sanitized before integration.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Pre-patch Hecton_SargassumMaster.shader used raw vertex/color/UV/time/prop-wash/cut/sink data in forward and shadow passes before motion, mask sampling, and alpha clip.
confirmedProblems.fix: Sargassum forward and shadow passes now sanitize finite inputs for sway, prop-wash, pulse, wound curl, cut mask, buoyancy sink, alpha clip, and final color.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_KelpMaster.shader had continuous quality/finite guards in forward pass, but shadow and depth passes still used raw motion inputs before deformation.
confirmedProblems.fix: Shadow and depth passes now sanitize position, normal, UV, time, sway, AUP offset, wash data, and use smooth _H8GlobalQualityWeight motion/interaction gates.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_CoralMaster.shader shadow pass sanitized position but transformed raw input.normalOS through shadow bias.
confirmedProblems.fix: Shadow caster now uses finite non-zero normal fallback before TransformObjectToWorldNormal and ApplyShadowBias.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_ProceduralBio.shader low LOD branch read input.positionWS while positionWS was compiled out under _MATH_LOD_LOW.
confirmedProblems.fix: positionWS is now emitted for all variants; low matcap/emission and high blend sharpness consume continuous _H8GlobalQualityWeight.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_SargassumCutMask.compute used authored texel size, scroll offset, recovery, and stamp vectors/strength before sampling and radius math.
confirmedProblems.fix: Texel size falls back to real result dimensions; scroll, recovery, stamps, samples, and output are finite-sanitized and stamp strength is saturated.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_SargassumDampingFacade.compute trusted output dimensions, density/cut rects, drift, pow exponents/scales; SargassumCrestDampingController sent fixed visual scales.
confirmedProblems.fix: Compute clamps to shared output dimensions and finite-sanitizes rect/pow/output paths; owner scales visual facade intensity by continuous GlobalQualityWeight.

confirmedProblems.evidence: Baseline Hecton_VegetationWakeTrailSim.compute looped over raw _HectonWakeTrailStampCount and used raw stamp/time/scroll/texel/damping/curl/wave/fade values.
confirmedProblems.fix: Shader caps stamps to the 4-entry owner buffer capacity and finite-sanitizes all wake inputs before sample, noise, velocity, displacement, and output writes.

confirmedProblems.evidence: TerrainMaster.shader still contains _MATH_LOD_LOW compile-time branches. Runtime terrain continuous quality binding was not proven in this pass.
confirmedProblems.fix: Not fixed in this pass. Recorded as residual risk for a focused terrain material/quality contract pass; blind mutation was rejected.
